spell.rpg_power.armor_arcane.name: Arcane Armor
spell.rpg_power.armor_arcane.description: Protects you or a friendly player: 20% less damage taken, +10% for each extra spell in your tome, up to 80%. Lasts 10 s with a 30 s cooldown, +5 s and +15 s for each extra spell, up to 40 s and 120 s.

effect.rpg_power.evasion.description: Chance to take only half damage
spell.rpg_power.evasion_archer.name: Evasion
spell.rpg_power.evasion_archer.descripti: Gives you a 20% chance to evade hits, +10% for each extra spell in your tome, up to 80%. An evaded hit still deals half damage. Self only. Lasts 10 s with a 30 s cooldown, +5 s and +15 s for each extra spell, up to 40 s and 120 s.

effect.rpg_power.stunned.description: Cannot move, attack or use abilities
spell.rpg_power.stun_warrior.name: Stun
spell.rpg_power.stun_warrior.description: Stuns nearby creatures (not players or bosses) within 3 blocks for 3 seconds: they cannot move, attack or use abilities. +1 block and +1 second for each extra spell in your tome, up to 8 blocks and 8 seconds.
